Distribute / report generation"},{"id":"program.activate","label":"Runtime activation
Scope / features / rollback floor"},{"id":"evaluate","label":"02 / EVALUATE AND ISSUE"},{"id":"evaluate.input","label":"Exact operation
Current issued source admission"},{"id":"evaluate.cedar","label":"Existing Cedar Rust + Lean
Same input / full diagnostics"},{"id":"evaluate.profile","label":"Required execution gate
Allow AND empty error IDs"},{"id":"evaluate.grant","label":"Signed receipt / one-use grant
Protected issue extension"},{"id":"execute","label":"03 / CONSUME AND ENFORCE"},{"id":"execute.consume","label":"Original issuer
Consume exact grant once"},{"id":"execute.commit","label":"S4 fenced ledger commit
History / budget / audit / source"},{"id":"execute.broker","label":"S5 final broker
Claim / final gate / one invocation"},{"id":"execute.release","label":"S6 response disclosure gate
Exact peer / range / premise"},{"id":"reject","label":"REJECT EXECUTABLE ADMISSION
No grant / abort only an existing unclaimed attempt"},{"id":"rule","label":"A policy allow alone is not execution authority.
Scheme owns semantics; Go integrates cloud services; Rust enforces physical guards. Cedar is not the ledger or external effect proof."}],"edges":[{"id":"program.(author -> closure)[0]","source":"program.author","target":"program.closure","label":"Approve exact closure"},{"id":"program.(closure -> cloud)[0]","source":"program.closure","target":"program.cloud","label":"Admitted publication"},{"id":"program.(cloud -> activate)[0]","source":"program.cloud","target":"program.activate","label":"ACK is not activation"},{"id":"(program.activate -> evaluate.input)[0]","source":"program.activate","target":"evaluate.input","label":"Active closure"},{"id":"(program.activate -> reject)[0]","source":"program.activate","target":"reject","label":"Incompatible / unauthorized"},{"id":"evaluate.(input -> cedar)[0]","source":"evaluate.input","target":"evaluate.cedar","label":"Exact subject"},{"id":"evaluate.(cedar -> profile)[0]","source":"evaluate.cedar","target":"evaluate.profile","label":"Preserve Cedar result"},{"id":"evaluate.(profile -> grant)[0]","source":"evaluate.profile","target":"evaluate.grant","label":"All required checks pass"},{"id":"(evaluate.grant -> execute.consume)[0]","source":"evaluate.grant","target":"execute.consume","label":"Bound grant"},{"id":"execute.(consume -> commit)[0]","source":"execute.consume","target":"execute.commit","label":"Positive consumption / not send authority"},{"id":"execute.(commit -> broker)[0]","source":"execute.commit","target":"execute.broker","label":"Current claim premise"},{"id":"execute.(broker -> release)[0]","source":"execute.broker","target":"execute.release","label":"Upstream result is not release permission"},{"id":"(evaluate -> reject)[0]","source":"evaluate","target":"reject","label":"Invalid / stale / missing witness / runtime failure / deny / errors / mismatch"}],"generatedDecorations":[]}

g.title: A policy allow alone is not execution authority. Scheme owns semantics; Go integrates cloud services; Rust enforces physical guards. Cedar is not the ledger or external effect proof.
